columns.$description: Status: Experimental. Shared grid column count by layout context. Compact, Medium and Wide are context modes; breakpoint thresholds are defined separately.

gutter.$description: Status: Experimental. DTCG type: dimension (px). Shared gutter width by layout context.

margin.$description: Status: Experimental. DTCG type: dimension (px). Minimum outer page margin by layout context.

max-width.$description: Status: Experimental. DTCG type: dimension (px). A value of 0 means fluid width; Wide caps the primary content container at 1200 px.
